edits.previous: The [Python/Ruby archive](fin-python-ruby-20261008/receipt.json) preserves 18 reports from frozen producer `72c5e27`, plus each runtime's original runner, TAP output and queue. All six selected tests per runtime passed without failures or skips. Two independent author roots reproduced the packages, followed by source/build deletion and compiler-free offline installation. Both Python versions produced identical JSON, so the separate execution logs establish which interpreter ran. These local runs used Node 22.23.2 and an explicit glibc minimum of 2.36. Package hashes are retained; the binary archives themselves are not. Dispatch and hosted CI remain unmeasured. The [archive tests](../../tests/fin-python-ruby-evidence.test.mjs) authenticate exact caller bytes, refinement trees, reviewed decisions, package identities and runtime-specific execution records; inventory promotion remains separate.
edits.current: The [Python/Ruby archive](fin-python-ruby-20261008/receipt-v2.json) preserves 18 reports from frozen producer `72c5e27`, plus each runtime's original runner, TAP output and queue. All six selected tests per runtime passed without failures or skips. Two independent author roots reproduced the packages, followed by source/build deletion and compiler-free offline installation. Both Python versions produced identical JSON. Each runner recorded the version of its configured interpreter before the selections; the installer used that executable. The consumers did not print their versions. The runners recorded Node 22.23.2 and configured a glibc minimum of 2.36. Their retained logs declare a 2.36 host and select a Lean 4.32.2 path, but do not measure either version. The corrected receipt records that distinction and retains the [first receipt](fin-python-ruby-20261008/receipt.json) unchanged. Its selected source pins are not a complete dependency closure. Package hashes are retained; the binary archives themselves are not. Dispatch and hosted CI remain unmeasured. The [archive tests](../../tests/fin-python-ruby-evidence.test.mjs) authenticate exact caller bytes, refinement trees, reviewed decisions, package identities and runtime-specific execution records; inventory promotion remains separate.
